course: Advanced TypeScript and Library API Design

cases.title: Structural assignment accepts extra stored fields
cases.target: structural source-to-target compatibility
cases.principledRepair: Keep the richer source while exposing only the named contract.
cases.weakRepair: Use an assertion to hide an actual missing member.

cases.title: Fresh literal receives excess-property checking
cases.target: fresh object literal excess-property check
cases.principledRepair: Remove or model the unsupported role field.
cases.weakRepair: Assign through a variable merely to evade the diagnostic.

cases.title: satisfies checks without broad annotation widening
cases.target: satisfies preserves the expression type
cases.principledRepair: Use satisfies when checking a value while preserving literals.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the entire object as the target type.

cases.title: Exact optional properties reject present undefined
cases.target: exactOptionalPropertyTypes distinguishes absence from undefined
cases.principledRepair: Omit the property or include undefined in its value type deliberately.
cases.weakRepair: Disable exact optional property checking.

cases.title: Distinct brands prevent accidental interchange
cases.target: nominal witness layered over structural primitives
cases.principledRepair: Construct branded values only at the validating boundary.
cases.weakRepair: Export a broad assertion helper that brands arbitrary strings.

cases.title: Different brands are not interchangeable
cases.target: unique-symbol brand identity
cases.principledRepair: Convert through an explicit validated mapping if the domains correspond.
cases.weakRepair: Cast through unknown.

cases.title: Readonly does not freeze an aliased object
cases.target: readonly is a static capability, not runtime immutability
cases.principledRepair: Use runtime freezing or ownership isolation when the product needs immutability.
cases.weakRepair: Assume a readonly view prevents other aliases from mutating.

cases.title: Assertion does not validate runtime shape
cases.target: assertions are erased and cannot establish runtime evidence
cases.principledRepair: Validate unknown input before constructing the trusted type.
cases.weakRepair: Add another assertion nearer the failing call.

cases.title: Indexed access preserves selected value type
cases.target: K relates the key to T and T[K]
cases.principledRepair: Keep the key generic and constrained by keyof T.
cases.weakRepair: Return unknown and require every caller to assert.

cases.title: Broad string key loses the proven relationship
cases.target: string is wider than the known key set
cases.principledRepair: Narrow or validate the dynamic string before selection.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the string to keyof typeof value without checking it.

cases.title: Const tuple preserves projection order
cases.target: const inference retains tuple positions
cases.principledRepair: Accept a readonly const key tuple and map each index.
cases.weakRepair: Return an unordered array union.

cases.title: Projection cannot request an absent key
cases.target: key tuple is constrained by source keys
cases.principledRepair: Add role to the source or choose a real key.
cases.weakRepair: Widen the source to Record<string, unknown>.

cases.title: NoInfer keeps a fallback from driving inference
cases.target: NoInfer blocks one inference source while preserving assignability
cases.principledRepair: Use NoInfer only when another argument owns inference.
cases.weakRepair: Specify every type argument manually in all calls.

cases.title: Fallback must still satisfy the inferred type
cases.target: NoInfer does not remove assignability checks
cases.principledRepair: Provide a fallback inside the inferred domain.
cases.weakRepair: Cast an unsupported fallback.

cases.title: Runtime projection preserves requested order
cases.target: type relation corresponds to deterministic runtime traversal
cases.principledRepair: Traverse the same ordered key tuple used by the type.
cases.weakRepair: Use Object.keys and assume matching order.

cases.title: Unchecked dynamic key can produce undefined
cases.target: index signatures permit absence under strict indexed access
cases.principledRepair: Validate membership and handle the missing branch.
cases.weakRepair: Use a non-null assertion.

cases.title: Conditional type extracts a promise value
cases.target: infer extracts a related component from the matched structure
cases.principledRepair: Use infer inside the true branch of a structural pattern.
cases.weakRepair: Duplicate the inner type manually.

cases.title: Extracted output must match the inferred component
cases.target: conditional extraction preserves the inner number
cases.principledRepair: Use a number or change the source promise type.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the string as Result.

cases.title: Naked type parameter distributes over a union
cases.target: distributive conditional types evaluate each union member
cases.principledRepair: Keep T naked when per-member transformation is intended.
cases.weakRepair: Manually enumerate every current union member.

cases.title: Tuple wrapping suppresses distribution
cases.target: non-distributive conditional retains the original union
cases.principledRepair: Use a value from the retained union.
cases.weakRepair: Widen the union to string.

cases.title: never removes impossible branches from unions
cases.target: never is the identity element removed from a union
cases.principledRepair: Use never for genuinely impossible filtered branches.
cases.weakRepair: Use unknown, which would swallow precision.

cases.title: Filtered union rejects removed members
cases.target: conditional filter removed the numeric member
cases.principledRepair: Provide a remaining string member.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the number.

cases.title: Runtime dispatch follows the same discriminant
cases.target: static conditional model must correspond to runtime discriminant behavior
cases.principledRepair: Dispatch on the same stable tag used by the type family.
cases.weakRepair: Infer outcomes from an unrelated property.

cases.title: Assertion-based dispatcher can reach an unsupported branch
cases.target: static assertion cannot constrain external runtime variants
cases.principledRepair: Validate the discriminant from unknown input.
cases.weakRepair: Delete the runtime guard because the type says ping.

cases.title: Mapped type preserves property value relationships
cases.target: mapped iteration keeps the source key set
cases.principledRepair: Derive the family from keyof the source model.
cases.weakRepair: Maintain a second handwritten interface.

cases.title: Mapped result requires every retained key
cases.target: modifier preservation keeps required keys required
cases.principledRepair: Provide age or deliberately remove requiredness.
cases.weakRepair: Assert a partial object as complete.

cases.title: Key remapping derives an event family
cases.target: template literal names remain related to source value types
cases.principledRepair: Remap each string key while indexing the original property type.
cases.weakRepair: Use Record<string, (value: unknown) => void>.

cases.title: Derived event payload rejects a wrong value type
cases.target: activeChanged consumes the source Boolean type
cases.principledRepair: Pass a Boolean.
cases.weakRepair: Widen the callback parameter to unknown.

cases.title: Modifier mapping can make fields writable and required
cases.target: mapped modifiers add and remove capabilities explicitly
cases.principledRepair: Use -readonly and -? only when the derived contract requires them.
cases.weakRepair: Disable strict optional checking.

cases.title: Symbol keys require a separate key policy
cases.target: keyof includes symbol while template literals require primitive text domains
cases.principledRepair: Extract string keys before interpolation.
cases.weakRepair: Cast keyof Model to string.

cases.title: Generated event name and payload agree at runtime
cases.target: runtime construction mirrors the mapped event relation
cases.principledRepair: Build both name and payload from the same key.
cases.weakRepair: Accept independent strings for type and key.

cases.title: Unchecked generated name can select no handler
cases.target: broad string lookup does not establish membership
cases.principledRepair: Validate event-name membership before dispatch.
cases.weakRepair: Use a non-null assertion.

cases.title: A wider consumer can handle a narrower value
cases.target: function parameters are contravariant under strict function types
cases.principledRepair: A callback accepting all animals can safely receive dogs.
cases.weakRepair: Reverse the assignment based on return-type intuition.

cases.title: A dog-only consumer cannot accept every animal
cases.target: narrow callback parameter would receive unsupported values
cases.principledRepair: Use an Animal consumer or narrow before invoking dog behavior.
cases.weakRepair: Declare the callback as a method to exploit bivariance.

cases.title: Readonly producer is covariant
cases.target: output-only type parameter varies covariantly
cases.principledRepair: Expose read-only production for covariant substitution.
cases.weakRepair: Add an input method while keeping the out annotation.

cases.title: Variance annotation rejects contradictory usage
cases.target: declared covariance conflicts with an input position
cases.principledRepair: Split producer and consumer capabilities or remove the false annotation.
cases.weakRepair: Suppress the diagnostic.

cases.title: Invariant mutable box prevents unsafe substitution
cases.target: read-write capability requires invariance
cases.principledRepair: Keep the same element type across substitution.
cases.weakRepair: Expose only get or only set if that is the true capability.

cases.title: Invariant box does not widen
cases.target: wider box could write a number into string storage
cases.principledRepair: Keep the invariant type or expose a read-only view.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the box.

cases.title: Listener snapshot makes removal during dispatch deterministic
cases.target: runtime dispatch policy is separate from callback variance
cases.principledRepair: Iterate over a snapshot when mutation during notification is supported.
cases.weakRepair: Rely on incidental Set iteration mutation behavior.

cases.title: Mutable array covariance can fail at runtime
cases.target: mutable array substitution permits an incompatible write
cases.principledRepair: Expose readonly arrays across covariant boundaries.
cases.weakRepair: Assert every retrieved element as Dog.

cases.title: Type-only imports disappear from emitted JavaScript
cases.target: types can support checking without runtime bindings
cases.principledRepair: Use import type for declarations used only statically.
cases.weakRepair: Ship fake runtime values for every type.

cases.title: A type-only import cannot be used as a value
cases.target: type namespace has no emitted runtime binding
cases.principledRepair: Use a real value export or keep the use in a type position.
cases.weakRepair: Invent a global variable named Imported.

cases.title: Overload implementation covers declared calls
cases.target: overload declarations must be supported by one runtime implementation
cases.principledRepair: Keep implementation input and output broad enough for every overload.
cases.weakRepair: Declare overloads that runtime code does not distinguish.

cases.title: Consumer cannot call an undeclared overload
cases.target: public overload set defines supported calls
cases.principledRepair: Add and implement a Boolean overload only if runtime behavior exists.
cases.weakRepair: Cast true to string.

cases.title: Declaration-shaped interface can model existing runtime
cases.target: declaration surface describes callable runtime members
cases.principledRepair: Test the declaration against the actual JavaScript module.
cases.weakRepair: Assume structural consistency proves runtime alignment.

cases.title: Declaration consumer detects a missing member
cases.target: declared required member is absent
cases.principledRepair: Implement value or make it optional only if runtime permits absence.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the object as Counter.

cases.title: Runtime and declaration can align
cases.target: runtime behavior must be tested independently of type consistency
cases.principledRepair: Exercise the JavaScript implementation through the typed facade.
cases.weakRepair: Inspect only the .d.ts file.

cases.title: Ambient declaration can name a nonexistent runtime value
cases.target: declare emits no JavaScript and creates no runtime value
cases.principledRepair: Provide an actual runtime export matching the declaration.
cases.weakRepair: Add another ambient declaration.

cases.title: NodeNext ESM uses explicit relative extension
cases.target: ESM output and resolution agree on module identity
cases.principledRepair: Use .js specifiers for emitted ESM relative imports.
cases.weakRepair: Switch resolution modes merely to omit extensions.

cases.title: Default import requires a default export
cases.target: module export kind must match import kind
cases.principledRepair: Use a named import.
cases.weakRepair: Enable unrelated interoperability flags.

cases.title: Type-only surface can be re-exported explicitly
cases.target: verbatim module syntax distinguishes type exports
cases.principledRepair: Use export type for type-only names.
cases.weakRepair: Rely on elision guesses.

cases.title: Type-only value import is rejected
cases.target: a type alias is not a runtime binding
cases.principledRepair: Use the class value directly or import it as a value.
cases.weakRepair: Manufacture a declaration for Imported.

cases.title: Public API can hide implementation class
cases.target: public return contract need not expose concrete implementation
cases.principledRepair: Return the narrow supported interface.
cases.weakRepair: Export every internal class.

cases.title: Consumer cannot rely on private implementation members
cases.target: narrow public surface omits internal capability
cases.principledRepair: Expose a supported diagnostic interface only if required.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the public value to the concrete class.

cases.title: ESM helper import executes through emitted .js path
cases.target: runtime path must correspond to emitted JavaScript
cases.principledRepair: Test built output and package entry points.
cases.weakRepair: Test only source imports through a custom loader.

cases.title: Unsupported subpath is a product failure even when a file exists
cases.target: package export map defines supported entry points
cases.principledRepair: Add a deliberate export or remove the consumer dependency.
cases.weakRepair: Deep-import a dist file.

cases.title: Infer extracts schema output
cases.target: schema value and output type remain related
cases.principledRepair: Extract the output from the schema type parameter.
cases.weakRepair: Handwrite a duplicate output interface.

cases.title: Inferred schema output rejects the wrong value
cases.target: number schema output remains numeric
cases.principledRepair: Use a number or change the schema.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the string.

cases.title: Object shape maps schemas to outputs
cases.target: mapped type projects each schema output by key
cases.principledRepair: Keep shape keys and output keys in one relation.
cases.weakRepair: Use Record<string, unknown>.

cases.title: Object output preserves field types
cases.target: age schema output is number
cases.principledRepair: Provide a number.
cases.weakRepair: Change the output map to unknown.

cases.title: Unknown input requires narrowing before use
cases.target: unknown forces runtime evidence before trusted use
cases.principledRepair: Narrow or validate at the boundary.
cases.weakRepair: Accept input as string from an untrusted source.

cases.title: Unknown cannot be returned as trusted output
cases.target: unknown is not assignable to string
cases.principledRepair: Validate typeof before return.
cases.weakRepair: Assert input as string.

cases.title: Decoder reports a path at runtime
cases.target: runtime diagnostics carry evidence unavailable to static types
cases.principledRepair: Build paths during nested validation.
cases.weakRepair: Return only false.

cases.title: Assertion-based schema accepts an invalid value until use
cases.target: assertion cannot replace runtime validation
cases.principledRepair: Parse from unknown through a validator.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the nested field separately.

cases.title: Optional additive field preserves old object construction
cases.target: optional addition can preserve source compatibility
cases.principledRepair: Add optional data with documented absence semantics.
cases.weakRepair: Add a required field and call it minor.

cases.title: New required field breaks old callers
cases.target: required property changes construction contract
cases.principledRepair: Provide tags or stage the change through an optional/versioned form.
cases.weakRepair: Assert old values as the new response.

cases.title: Versioned union supports explicit migration
cases.target: version tags make compatibility behavior explicit
cases.principledRepair: Migrate each supported old version deliberately.
cases.weakRepair: Mutate old data in place without a version boundary.

cases.title: Exhaustive consumer breaks when union grows
cases.target: new union member reaches exhaustive never check
cases.principledRepair: Handle cancelled or treat union extension as breaking.
cases.weakRepair: Add a default that hides future cases.

cases.title: Deprecated alias can preserve a source path temporarily
cases.target: compatibility alias preserves the same structural contract
cases.principledRepair: Document and time-box the migration path.
cases.weakRepair: Keep aliases forever without ownership.

cases.title: Narrowed input parameter rejects old valid calls
cases.target: input-domain narrowing is breaking
cases.principledRepair: Keep the old input or publish a major-version change.
cases.weakRepair: Cast old inputs.

cases.title: Migration preserves modeled meaning
cases.target: migration maps semantics, not merely syntax
cases.principledRepair: Test representative and boundary fixtures.
cases.weakRepair: Rename fields without defining default semantics.

cases.title: Removed runtime behavior fails despite compatible-looking types
cases.target: structural type compatibility does not prove behavioral compatibility
cases.principledRepair: Retain behavior, adapt it, or publish the breaking change.
cases.weakRepair: Leave the old signature while throwing for every old call.

cases.title: Public facade can hide an implementation type
cases.target: supported facade is narrower than implementation
cases.principledRepair: Export the stable contract and factory.
cases.weakRepair: Expose internal constructors for tests.

cases.title: Facade consumer cannot use hidden implementation methods
cases.target: public surface omits internal debug capability
cases.principledRepair: Add a supported public diagnostic contract if required.
cases.weakRepair: Cast to the hidden class.

cases.title: Runtime parser and inferred type can align
cases.target: one schema value owns runtime and static output relationship
cases.principledRepair: Derive output from the schema value.
cases.weakRepair: Maintain separate runtime and static definitions.

cases.title: Integrated output rejects incompatible consumer data
cases.target: consumer output follows schema output exactly
cases.principledRepair: Use number output or change the schema.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the object.

cases.title: Compatibility fixture preserves an old version
cases.target: versioned migration remains part of release evidence
cases.principledRepair: Keep old fixtures in tests.
cases.weakRepair: Delete old fixtures after the new version parses.

cases.title: Unsupported future version is not silently trusted
cases.target: literal version discriminant prevents silent substitution
cases.principledRepair: Add an explicit V3 parser and compatibility policy.
cases.weakRepair: Widen format to string.

cases.title: Complete library flow is deterministic
cases.target: runtime rendering follows one stable public order
cases.principledRepair: Define canonical ordering at the product boundary.
cases.weakRepair: Rely on accidental internal object creation order.

cases.title: Unsupported independent extension must fail explicitly
cases.target: architecture must reject unsupported capabilities honestly
cases.principledRepair: Implement the extension across runtime, type, declaration, package, test, and compatibility surfaces.
cases.weakRepair: Pretend the feature exists in declarations only.
